assembly_instructions: 1) Bolt the four carbon arms (arm_fl/fr/rl/rr) onto the bottom_plate at 45 degrees. 2) Stand the four corner standoffs on the bottom_plate and cap them with the top_plate, sandwiching the arms. 3) Mount the 4-in-1 esc_board on the bottom_plate, then stack fc_board and vtx_board above it on 30.5 mm standoffs. 4) Fasten each motor_base to its arm tip and press on the motor_bell rotor. 5) Bolt the three pitched blades onto each motor_bell to form the tri-blade props. 6) Clip the camera_body into the front camera_cage and thread the camera_lens; route signal to fc_board. 7) Fit the antenna_mount at the rear and screw in the antenna_whip from the vtx_board. 8) Strap the LiPo battery onto the top_plate with the battery_strap and connect it to the esc_board.

metadata.info: A 5-inch-class freestyle/racing FPV quadcopter on a carbon-fiber true-X frame, scaled approximately 14x from real dimensions for legibility.
facts: Wheelbase ~220 mm (5-inch class), measured motor-to-motor across the diagonal.
Motors are 2207-size (22 mm stator dia, 7 mm height), ~2400 KV brushless outrunners.
Propellers are 5x4.3x3 tri-blade, 127 mm diameter, two CW and two CCW.
Battery is 6S LiPo (22.2 V nominal, 25.2 V full), 1300 mAh, ~95C discharge.
All-up weight is roughly 600 g ready-to-fly.
Flight-controller stack uses the 30.5 x 30.5 mm mounting pattern on M3 standoffs.
Video transmitter runs 5.8 GHz analog, switchable up to 800 mW.
Carbon plates are ~2 mm thick; arms are ~5 mm thick for impact resistance.
Top speed is roughly 140 km/h in level flight.
sources: T-Motor F40 PRO II / 2207 brushless motor datasheet

parts.name: 4-in-1 ESC Board
parts.role: Bottom board of the stack; switches battery current to all four motors. Shown separated from the boards above for legibility.

parts.name: Flight Controller Board
parts.role: Middle board of the stack; runs the gyro and flight-control firmware. Shown separated to expose the stack interior.

parts.name: Video Transmitter Board
parts.role: Top board of the stack; encodes the camera feed onto 5.8 GHz. Shown separated to expose the stack interior.

parts.name: Camera Cage
parts.role: TPU bracket at the front of the frame that holds and protects the FPV camera.

parts.name: FPV Camera Body
parts.role: Analog CMOS micro camera canted ~30 degrees up to set the forward-flight viewing angle.

parts.name: Camera Lens
parts.role: Wide-angle M12 lens projecting the pilot's first-person view onto the sensor.

parts.name: Antenna Mount
parts.role: Rear bracket that anchors the video-transmitter antenna clear of the props.

parts.name: VTX Antenna
parts.role: 5.8 GHz circular-polarized antenna radiating the analog video downlink to the pilot's goggles.

parts.name: LiPo Battery
parts.role: 6S 1300 mAh high-discharge LiPo pack supplying ~22 V to the ESC via an XT60 lead.

parts.name: Battery Strap
parts.role: Grippy hook-and-loop strap clamping the battery onto the top plate against flight loads.
